subject: pharmacology
title: Lamotrigine and Carbamazepine in Bipolar Prophylaxis, Buspirone and Anti Anxiety Adjuncts

steps.tx: **Lamotrigine** owns bipolar depression prophylaxis: it prevents depressive relapses significantly, manic relapses weakly, and treats acute bipolar depression modestly, the mirror image of lithium's manic pole strength, so the two are rational partners across the poles. Its price is patience (the slow rash avoiding titration from the epilepsy lessons, halved further beside valproate) and the absence of acute antimanic power, which forbids it as monotherapy where mania is the presenting danger.
steps.say: Lamotrigine guards the depressive pole while lithium guards the manic; pair them by pole, not by habit.

vis.alt: Bipolar mood spectrum diagram showing manic, hypomanic, euthymic and depressive poles
vis.caption: The bipolar spectrum whose depressive pole lamotrigine preferentially protects.

steps.tx: **Bipolar disorder prophylaxis** assembles by episode history: lithium for classic euphoric mania and suicide risk, valproate for rapid cycling and mixed features (teratogenicity fenced), lamotrigine for depressive predominance, carbamazepine as later line where its interaction empire can be afforded, and atypical antipsychotics (quetiapine across all phases, aripiprazole manic pole) woven through. Maintenance is measured in years, reviewed against relapse calendars, and antidepressants are never left unopposed by a stabiliser in bipolar depression.
steps.say: Prophylaxis is chosen by the pole that hurts the patient most, and antidepressants never ride alone in bipolar illness.

left.title: Pole matched prophylaxis
points: Manic pole: lithium, valproate, aripiprazole, quetiapine
Depressive pole: lamotrigine, quetiapine, lithium
Mixed and rapid cycling: valproate or carbamazepine traditions
Suicide risk: lithium evidence unique

right.title: Maintenance discipline
points: Years, not months, after recurrent episodes
Relapse signature taught to patient and family
Levels and organs monitored by agent
Antidepressant monotherapy avoided in bipolar depression

steps.tx: **Carbamazepine** in bipolar care is the veteran third line: antimanic and prophylactic efficacy proven historically, burdened by autoinduction, contraceptive and antipsychotic level sabotage, hyponatraemia, blood dyscrasias and HLA flagged skin reactions from the epilepsy lessons. Its niche persists where lithium and valproate fail or are forbidden and its interactions can be actively managed, a shrinking but examinable territory. Levels, sodium, full blood count and liver profile accompany it by schedule.
steps.say: Carbamazepine stabilises mood third in line; its interaction empire must be governed, not discovered.

nodes.label: Lithium and valproate failed or forbidden
HLA screening and baseline bloods completed
Titration with autoinduction anticipated at weeks 3 to 5
Interaction audit at every co prescription

steps.tx: **Buspirone**, a serotonin 5 HT1A partial agonist, treats generalised anxiety without sedation, dependence, withdrawal or sexual dysfunction, and without helping panic attacks acutely because benefit needs two to four weeks of thrice daily dosing (short half life). It does not substitute for benzodiazepines in dependent patients (no cross tolerance, withdrawal proceeds untreated) and augments SSRIs in depression protocols. Grapefruit and CYP3A4 inhibitors raise its levels; dizziness and headache are its plain tolls.
steps.say: Buspirone is the patient anxiolytic: no sedation, no dependence, no use in a hurry.

left.title: Buspirone profile
points: 5 HT1A partial agonism, no GABA activity
Generalised anxiety over 2 to 4 weeks
No dependence, sedation or withdrawal
SSRI augmentation role in depression

right.title: Buspirone limits
points: Useless for acute panic relief
No benzodiazepine cross cover in withdrawal
Thrice daily dosing from short half life
CYP3A4 inhibitors multiply exposure

steps.tx: **Propranolol in performance anxiety** is applied autonomic pharmacology: beta blockade silences the peripheral tremor, palpitation and flushing that feed stage fright's vicious circle, dosed 10 to 40 mg an hour before the event in patients without asthma or bradycardia, without touching the cognitive worry itself. It is not a treatment for generalised anxiety or panic disorder, and examinations reward that boundary. Musicians, speakers and examinees are its classic vignettes; test doses precede performances.
steps.say: Propranolol mutes the body's stage fright instruments; it does nothing for the mind's, and asthma bans it.

nodes.label: Performance with tremor and palpitation dread
Propranolol test dose on a safe day first
No asthma, bradycardia or hypotension history

steps.tx: Stage fright feeds on its own body signals. **Propranolol** blocks peripheral beta receptors and quiets tremor, palpitation and flushing, at 10 to 40 mg about an hour before performing, if there is no asthma or bradycardia. Worrying thoughts stay untouched, and generalised anxiety or panic are not indications. Musicians, speakers and examinees are the usual users, and a test dose on an ordinary day should come first.
steps.say: Ten to 40 mg of propranolol about an hour before performing blocks the tremor, palpitation and flush that make stage fright worse. It does not treat the anxious thoughts, and it is not a drug for generalised anxiety or panic. Asthma and a slow pulse forbid it. A trial dose should precede the real performance.

vis.alt: Propranolol is shown blocking peripheral beta receptors so that tremor, palpitation and flushing of performance anxiety stop.
vis.caption: Peripheral beta receptors are blocked so the tremor, rapid pulse and flush of stage fright are silenced, while the mental worry is left untouched. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: **Hydroxyzine**, a first generation antihistamine with anxiolytic licensing, sedates through H1 blockade with anticholinergic baggage, QT prolongation warnings that capped its dose and duration in regulators' reviews, and next day impairment that limits it to short courses where benzodiazepines are being avoided. It illustrates the sedative antihistamine trap in elderly patients, where anticholinergic burden trades anxiety for confusion and falls, and guidelines increasingly steer chronic anxiety to SSRIs, SNRIs, buspirone and psychological therapy.
steps.say: Hydroxyzine sedates anxiety at an anticholinergic and QT price; short courses only, rarely in the elderly.

left.title: Hydroxyzine facts
points: H1 antihistamine anxiolytic, rapid sedation
QT prolongation: dose and duration capped by regulators
Anticholinergic effects, next day impairment
Short term bridging role at best

right.title: Chronic anxiety hierarchy
points: Psychological therapy foundational
SSRIs and SNRIs first line pharmacotherapy
Buspirone and pregabalin in defined niches
Benzodiazepines brief and exceptional

steps.tx: **Switching stabilisers** obeys each drug's clocks: lithium levels five days after dose changes, lamotrigine rash windows on every re titration after interruptions beyond five days (restart the full slow escalation), valproate's teratogenicity paperwork renewed annually, carbamazepine's autoinduction re levelling co prescriptions at a month. Cross tapers are choreographed on paper with the patient holding a copy, because bipolar relapse punishes improvisational pharmacology more than almost any other prescribing in this module.
steps.say: Every stabiliser switch is written choreography with dates; relapse is the critic of improvisation.

left.title: Clock watching by agent
points: Lithium: level 5 days after change, 12 hour sample
Lamotrigine: restart titration after 5 days missed
Valproate: annual risk acknowledgement where mandated
Carbamazepine: re level at autoinduction completion

right.title: Patient held plan
points: Written cross taper calendar
Early warning signs personalised
Crisis contacts and relapse actions
Family briefed with consent

steps.tx: **Pregnancy in bipolar disorder** concentrates every prior lesson: lithium's Ebstein arithmetic, valproate's prohibition tier, carbamazepine's folate story, lamotrigine's relative favour with level monitoring as clearance rises, and postpartum psychosis risk (highest after first delivery, with bipolar history) demanding prophylaxis plans written in the third trimester. Untreated relapse is the comparator in every cell of that table, which is why perinatal psychiatry co owns these prescriptions.
steps.say: Perinatal bipolar care weighs relapse against teratogenicity cell by cell, with lamotrigine and lithium usually surviving the audit.

Anomaly and fetal cardiac surveillance as indicated
